title: Reinforcement Learning Tools for Multi-Armed Bandit

title: Simulated Multi-Arm Bandit Dataset — MAB
text: simulated multi-armed bandit (MAB) dataset featuring complex   stimulus-response structure.   set four distinct stimuli (red, blue, yellow, green)   isomorphic set four available choices (, , left, right).   Crucially, multiple stimuli may map underlying choice   (e.g., Red Blue map '').   design requires reinforcement learning model learn   latent mapping observable stimuli set potential actions,   making challenging test case model fitting.

title: Simulated Multi-Arm Bandit Dataset — MAB
text: data frame 9000 rows 12 columns: Subject Subject ID, integer ranging 1 30. Block Block number, integer ranging 1 6. Trial Trial number within block, integer (1 50). Object_1, Object_2, Object_3, Object_4 Stimulus-response combinations (string) four objects, formatted       "Color_Direction" (e.g., "Red_Up"). column independently       balanced shuffled. Reward_1, Reward_2, Reward_3, Reward_4 Reward values four choice arms (Decks), following classic       Iowa Gambling Task (IGT) structure adjusted values. Reward_1 (Bad): High gain (+100) high frequency,           mid-sized fine (-250). Long-term net loss. Reward_2 (Bad): High gain (+100) low frequency,           large fine (-1250). Long-term net loss. Reward_3 (Good): Low gain (+50) high frequency,           small fine (-50). Long-term net gain. Reward_4 (Good): Low gain (+50) low frequency,           mid-sized fine (-250). Long-term net gain. Rewards balanced Block level. Action simulated choice made subject trial (string),       randomly sampled "", "", "Left", "Right".

title: Group 2 from Mason et al. (2024) — TAB
text: dataset originates Experiment 2 Mason et al. (2024),   titled "Rare extreme outcomes risky choice"   (doi:10.3758/s13423-023-02415-x ).   raw data publicly available Open Science Framework (OSF)   https://osf.io/hy3q4/.   purposes package, performed   basic cleaning preprocessing original dataset.

title: Group 2 from Mason et al. (2024) — TAB
text: data frame 45000 rows 11 columns: Subject Subject ID, integer (total 143). Block Block number, integer (1 6). Trial Trial number, integer (1 60). L_choice Left choice, character indicating option presented.       possible options : : 100% gain 36. B: 90% gain 40 10% gain 0. C: 100% lose 36. D: 90% lose 40 10% lose 0.  R_choice Right choice, character indicating option presented.       possible options : : 100% gain 36. B: 90% gain 40 10% gain 0. C: 100% lose 36. D: 90% lose 40 10% lose 0.  L_reward Reward associated left choice. R_reward Reward associated right choice. Sub_Choose chosen option, either L_choice R_choice. Frame Type frame, character string (e.g., "Gain", "Loss", "Catch"). NetWorth participant's net worth end trial. RT participant's reaction time (milliseconds) trial.
